context: Tests: avoiding implementation-detail assertions, real infrastructure in unit tests and skipped tests, and treating hard-to-test code as a design problem.

checklist.name: Real database in a unit test flagged
checklist.description: The review says a unit test must not connect to real Postgres and proposes a mock, stub or fake repository for unit tests

checklist.name: Real database kept for integration level
checklist.description: The review keeps real-database coverage as a separate integration test of the repository adapter

checklist.name: Implementation-detail assertion flagged
checklist.description: The review flags `spyOn(service, 'validateItems')` as testing an internal call rather than observable behaviour

checklist.name: Behaviour-based assertion proposed
checklist.description: The review proposes asserting on output or saved state given an input

checklist.name: Skipped test challenged
checklist.description: The review says the `it.skip` should not stay skipped because the code is hard to test

checklist.name: Root cause named as design
checklist.description: The review says the hard-coded SMTP client is a design problem, not a testing problem

checklist.name: Injection recommended for SMTP
checklist.description: The review recommends injecting an email interface or port for the confirmation email

checklist.name: Test double type chosen with reason
checklist.description: The review picks a mock for the email command and a stub or fake for the repository query, or explains the choice

checklist.name: No test-only workaround
checklist.description: The review does not recommend exposing private methods or adding test flags to make the old design testable

checklist.name: Boundary-level guidance given
checklist.description: The review ties the fix to testing at architectural boundaries (unit for logic, integration for adapters)
